title: Murder
grade_or_penalty: 1st degree; 30 years to life with 30 years parole ineligibility (life without parole in certain cases)
key_points: Purposely or knowingly causing death, or serious bodily injury that results in death.
Felony murder: death caused during robbery, sexual assault, arson, burglary, kidnapping, carjacking, escape or terrorism (or flight from them).
